warnings: A reboot is needed afterwards; uninstall never reboots.
follow_ups: /var/lib/pinka-kept holds the restic repository's password and location and the SFTP key of the backup server: they grant access to the backups. Copy it off this host, then delete it securely, as root: tar -C /var/lib -cf - pinka-kept | ssh <you>@<safe-host> 'umask 077; cat > pinka-kept.tar' (or copy it to removable media), then find /var/lib/pinka-kept -type f -exec shred -u {} + && rm -rf /var/lib/pinka-kept. On an SSD or a copy-on-write file system (btrfs) shred cannot reach every old copy: then also change the repository's password (restic key passwd, from the copy) and replace the SFTP key on the backup server.
Delete the node pinka-lab (192.0.2.20) in the Tailscale admin console (Machines): uninstall logs it out, which does not take it off the tailnet.
Revoke the platform's read-only deploy key SHA256:examplefingerprint on the Git host of the platform's repository: uninstall removes its private half from this host.
